title: The car race
evenTitleZh: 他们是什么时候在那里的？

lines.en: There is a car race near our town every year.
lines.zh: 在我们镇子附近每年都有一场汽车比赛。

lines.en: In 1995, there was a very big race.
lines.zh: 1995 年举行了一次盛大的比赛。

lines.en: There were hundreds of people there.
lines.zh: 许许多多的人都去了赛场。

lines.en: My wife and I were at the race.
Our friends Julie and Jack were there, too.
lines.zh: 我们的朋友朱莉和杰克也去了。

lines.en: You can see us in the crowd.
lines.zh: 你可以在人群中看到我们。

lines.en: We are standing on the left.
There were twenty cars in the race.
lines.zh: 参加比赛的有 20 辆汽车。

lines.en: There were English cars, French cars, German cars, Italian cars, American cars and Japanese cars.
lines.zh: 有英国、法国、德国、意大利、美国和日本的汽车。
比赛的结尾是激动人心的。
获胜者是比利·斯图尔特。

lines.en: He was in car number fifteen.
Five other cars were just behind him.
lines.zh: 其他 5 辆汽车紧跟在他后面。

lines.en: On the way home, my wife said to me,
lines.zh: 在回家的途中，我妻子对我说：
你可不是比利·斯图尔特！”
